name: General meeting minutes
lead: The attendance sheet, proxies and meeting notes are cross-checked against the bylaws and the meeting notice: ownership shares recounted, majorities checked resolution by resolution, then minutes ready to review. You settle every point before signing.

project.title: Annual general meeting of Oct 14, 2026, Maple Court (fictional)

sources.name: Roofing_Bid_Ridgeline.pdf
sources.kind: Roofing bid attached to the notice

extracts.text: Notice sent by registered mail on Sep 21, 2026 for a meeting on Oct 14, 2026 at 6:30 pm.
Present and represented: 24 owners out of 38, holding 6,912 of 10,000 ownership shares.
Mr Remy Archer (fictional), unit 31, 196 shares, gives his proxy to Ms Claire Fenton (fictional). Received Oct 13, 2026.
A proxy holder may not hold more than three proxies unless their own votes and those of the owners they represent do not exceed 10% of all votes.
Ms Claire Fenton: 312 shares of her own; proxies: Bellows (241), Carroll (178), Dunn (213), Archer (196). Total: 1,140 shares.
Waterproofing of the flat roof, Ridgeline Roofing (fictional) bid of $186,400 tax included. Absolute majority (majority of all owners' votes, clause 25).
Total: $175,600 before tax, tax 10% $17,560, i.e. $193,160 tax included.
R1 to R3 (meeting officers): for 6,912. R4 2025 accounts: for 5,940, against 600, abstain 372. R5 2027 budget of $142,000: for 6,120, against 792. R6 roof: for 5,180, against 1,210, abstain 472.
Before the R6 vote, Mr Bellows (fictional) objects to Mr Archer's proxy; the chair keeps the proxy.
No second vote on R6. Meeting closed at 8:55 pm.
The minutes are sent to owners who voted against or were absent within one month of the meeting.
Bid no. 2026-118, version 2 of Sep 9, 2026, replacing version 1 of Jul 2, 2026.
Mr Garner (fictional), 50 shares, leaves at 7:40 pm, before resolution 6.
If a proposal misses the absolute majority but gets at least one third of all votes, an immediate second vote may be held at simple majority.
The meeting notice is sent at least 21 days before the meeting date.

contradictions.title: Mr Archer's proxy exceeds the proxy limit
contradictions.impact: The 196 shares voted through this proxy are invalid: without them, R6 drops to 4,984 votes, below the 5,001 threshold.
